content: Client configs for stdio MCP: OpenCode opencode.json { mcp: { name: { type: 'local', command: ['npx','-y','pkg'], enabled: true, environment: {...} } } }; Codex CLI ~/.codex/config.toml [mcp_servers.name] command/args/env tables or 'codex mcp add name --env K=V -- cmd' (stdio only); Cursor ~/.cursor/mcp.json or <project>/.cursor/mcp.json with Claude-Desktop-style mcpServers { command, args, env }. All spawn node/npx subprocesses — same stdio servers work unchanged.
